messages:
Sarah (Finance Ops): Heads up — customer ACME Corp (acct acme-178) reports credit note amount doesn't match expected after mid-cycle downgrade. Invoice INV-2026-0897, credit appears CN-2345 draft for $480 but customer expected ~$120 net after proration. :thinking_face:
Alex (Support): Got the support ticket. Customer says they downgraded from Pro to Essentials on 2026-05-03. Billing page shows credit larger than they calculated. I have the user's repro steps.
Alex (Support): Steps they gave:
1) Change plan in console on 2026-05-03
2) System generated credit note CN-2345
3) Invoice INV-2026-0897 shows line items: pro-monthly $600, usage adjustments $0, tax 20% — customer expects prorated refund for days left.
Maria (Billing Eng): Can you paste the invoice JSON? Also did they have a PO on file? PO rules sometimes alter tax/proration.
Alex (Support): Invoice snippet:
```
{
  "invoice_id": "INV-2026-0897",
  "lines": [
    {"desc": "Pro plan - May", "amount": 60000, "prorated": false},
    {"desc": "Adjustment - downgrade credit", "amount": -48000}
  ],
  "tax": 12000
}
```
Amounts in cents. Customer has PO PO-ACME-21 and VAT applies.
Maria (Billing Eng): That's the issue — the proration flag is false on the original plan line. Our proration engine didn't mark that subscription as proratible because the plan had a legacy 'fixed-billing-cycle' tag. We recently changed tax calc order; tax was applied after credits which is wrong for EU VAT with PO settings.
Tim (Payments): If tax was calculated incorrectly, the credit note will look higher because tax on the refunded amount wasn't reduced. We need to re-run invoice calc with tax-before-credit for PO customers or apply reverse-charge logic.
Josh (SRE): I can repro on staging. Ran the downgrade flow with account acme-staging-1. Logs show billing-service used tariffs v2 but proration service fallbacked to legacy: `ProrationService: fallback=true, rule=legacy_cycle` at 2026-05-03T14:22:17Z
Maria (Billing Eng): Repro steps for engineering:
1) Create subscription with `billing_cycle=monthly`, `plan=pro`, `legacy_cycle=true`, `tax_region=EU-IE`, `po=PO-XXXXX`
2) Downgrade to `essentials` mid-cycle
3) Call `GET /v1/invoices/{invoice_id}`
Expected: credit = prorated_unused_amount - tax_adjustment
Observed: credit = prorated_unused_amount + tax_adjustment

Also relevant code:
```
// billing calc
credit = prorated(amount);
if (plan.legacy_cycle) applyLegacyTax(credit);
else applyTaxBeforeCredit(credit);
```

Maria (Billing Eng): Proposed fix: ensure tax calculation is run with `applyTaxBeforeCredit` when `po_present == true || tax_region in EU`. Also mark proration flag for plans unless explicitly disabled.
Sarah (Finance Ops): What does this mean for the customer's draft CN-2345? Can we issue a corrected credit note and partial refund quickly? They asked for an updated invoice to attach to PO.
Tim (Payments): Short term: we can issue an adjustment (manual credit) for the delta and mark CN-2345 void. I can create a refund for the net difference after Maria confirms amount. Will need accounting approval for manual credit > $1k.
Alex (Support): Customer is looking for timeline. Can we provide ETA?
Maria (Billing Eng): I'll open a PR today to change tax calc (small patch). Staging test and deploy to canary within 24-48 hours. If valid, we can run a backfill job to recompute credits for impacted invoices (script will write audit logs). Backfill ETA 3 business days.
Sarah (Finance Ops): OK. For immediate customer response: offer manual adjustment + updated invoice within 48 hours, and note automated fix/backfill timeline. I'll prepare communication and request accounting sign-off for manual credit.
billing-bot: Credit note CN-2345 created (draft) by billing-service at 2026-05-03T14:23:05Z :page_with_curl:
Alex (Support): I'll send that offer now and tag customer success. Ticket #TKT-10234 updated.
Tim (Payments): I'll queue the manual refund, hold until Maria posts the exact delta. :thumbsup:
Maria (Billing Eng): Delta estimate: original credit shown $480. Correct prorated net should be $100 (net) -> tax 20 => credit ~120. So delta ~360. I'll push exact numbers when PR tests finish.
Sarah (Finance Ops): Thanks — keep updates here. Also pls add impacted filter to the backfill: `po_present==true && tax_region in EU && date between 2026-05-01 and 2026-05-07`.
Alex (Support): noted. Closing loop with ACME in support now. :eyes:
